sentence: Substituting the corrected scores changes the combination selected for one of the 33 targets, S6K1, where WHIM with nearest neighbours replaces WHIM with a support vector machine.
consequence: With that substitution the cliff-specific test error of S6K1 would move from 0.803 to 0.741 pKi units, the panel mean increase in cliff-specific error would move from 12.8% to 12.6%, the mean selection optimism from 0.119 to 0.117 pKi units, and cliff error would still exceed global error for 26 of the 33 targets.
